summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the entry into an executive employment agreement with John R. Merrill, CFO, effective August 18, 2026. It provides a three-year term, $325,000 base salary, 60% target bonus, and 75,000 restricted shares vesting over four years. Termination provisions include nine months' salary and double-trigger change-in-control protection. This is a standard executive compensation arrangement, not a forced departure or special situation. The 8-K is routine; accordingly, the event does not constitute a special-situation category beyond an ordinary officer appointment.
